title: Open edX Stack Variables
description: Variables for Open edX LMS and CMS stack deployment.

OPENEDX_VERSION.description: Open edX release or git branch (e.g., 'master', 'open-release/quince.master').

LMS_HOST.description: Public domain/host for LMS web interface.

CMS_HOST.description: Public domain/host for Studio / CMS authoring interface.

LMS_PORT.description: Internal HTTP port for LMS WSGI server.

CMS_PORT.description: Internal HTTP port for CMS WSGI server.

OPENEDX_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for Django sessions and token encryption.

OPENEDX_BACKUP_DIR.description: Directory where backup archives are generated.

OPENEDX_THEME.description: Active Comprehensive Theme name for LMS and Studio.

OPENEDX_THEME_REPO_URL.description: Git repository URL of custom Comprehensive Theme.

OPENEDX_INSTALL_DIR.description: Directory where openedx-platform is checked out and deployed.

OPENEDX_IMPORT_DEMO_COURSE.description: Whether to import the edX demo course during setup.

OPENEDX_IMPORT_DEMO_LIBRARIES.description: Whether to import demo content libraries during setup.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_WORKERS.description: Whether to enable and launch Celery background workers.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_CELERY_BEAT.description: Whether to enable Celery Beat periodic task scheduler.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_MFES.description: Whether to build and route Micro-Frontends (Learning, Authn, Account, Authoring).

OPENEDX_MFE_AUTHORING_PORT.description: HTTP port for Course Authoring Micro-Frontend.
